evidence_method: Each cache index JSON was matched against the checkpoint dataset_contract source, difficulty, and chart_sha256. The audio_config feature_version/profile was then classified.
confirmed: The cache namespace contains both legacy event-audio-v4-rhythm 50 Hz records and rational_audio_queries_v1 records for chart identities present in Prism_Re_v2.
The current checkpoint dataset_audit.json has no per-chart audio/rhythm profile field, so it cannot identify which cache variant each training example consumed.
not_confirmed: These counts do not prove that every legacy cache record was consumed by Prism_Re_v2; cache records may come from earlier runs or alternate settings.
The checkpoint does not preserve per-example prepared audio profile or skeleton source provenance.
risk: The old fixed worker path could prepare song_form_v2 charts with legacy EventAudio. In v2, that path also changes FormSong.audio_profile and can enable the non-rational skeleton branch, so a mixed or legacy preparation run can combine legacy audio semantics and future planned-onset skeleton inputs with free-joint rational generation. Treat this checkpoint as provenance-incomplete and do not resume it across the repaired preparation contract; use finetune/new preparation after the training_inputs contract is recorded.
